howto.name: Upload a scanned PDF
howto.text: Drop a scanned PDF up to 500 MB. Works best on documents where text lines are visible.

howto.name: PrivaTools detects skew per page
howto.text: The algorithm analyses the text line angle on each page and computes the rotation needed to straighten it.

howto.name: Download the deskewed PDF
howto.text: Each page is rotated by its detected angle (typically -5° to +5°) and the corners are cropped to fit. Result: text rows are perfectly horizontal.

faq.q: My scans look fine — should I run deskew?
faq.a: If the text appears tilted by more than ~0.5°, deskew helps OCR accuracy noticeably. For perfectly straight scans it's a no-op.
Yes — rotated pages need a slightly larger canvas. PrivaTools fills the margins with the surrounding background color (usually white).

faq.q: Should I deskew before or after OCR?
faq.a: Always before. OCR engines are much more accurate on straight-line text.
